hook.name: v4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Shared swap-fee hook for the v4.fun launchpad. Charges ETH fees on buys (deducted from input in beforeSwap) and sells (deducted from output in afterSwap) using a volatility-adjusted rate that scales linearly between a pool's registered baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps based on the tick movement of the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.
